title: 39 By BP
description: EEG recordings from participants receiving laser stimuli of calibrated intensity to evoke pain. After individual calibration to the energy level yielding an average rating of 7, each participant received 10 laser stimulations and rated pain intensity and unpleasantness on a 0-10 numeric rating scale. The dataset supports research on pain perception and related neural responses.
methods_description: Laser stimulation intensity was calibrated per participant to the energy corresponding to a mean rating of 7. Participants then received 10 laser stimuli while fixating on a crosshair with eyes open. After each stimulus there was a 5-second pause, followed by ratings of pain intensity and unpleasantness on a 0-10 NRS, given by mouse click on a screen axis (decimal values allowed). The next trial began randomly 5 seconds after the rating.
